description: NaN(SO₂F)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SNO₂F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.73 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two S atoms. Both N-S bond lengths are 1.59 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two S atoms. There is one shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.59 Å) N-S bond length. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to one N, two O, and one F atom to form SNO₂F tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SNO₂F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. There is one shorter (1.43 Å) and one longer (1.45 Å) S-O bond length. The S-F bond length is 1.60 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to one N, two O, and one F atom to form SNO₂F tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SNO₂F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-49°. There is one shorter (1.44 Å) and one longer (1.45 Å) S-O bond length. The S-F bond length is 1.61 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to one N, two O, and one F atom to form SNO₂F tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SNO₂F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There is one shorter (1.43 Å) and one longer (1.44 Å) S-O bond length. The S-F bond length is 1.60 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to one N, two O, and one F atom to form SNO₂F tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SNO₂F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-49°. There is one shorter (1.44 Å) and one longer (1.45 Å) S-O bond length. The S-F bond length is 1.60 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom.
